name: How to Edit Text in a PDF
description: Fix a typo or small text change inside a PDF — 100% in your browser.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose file' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. PDFree checks how cleanly the document can be turned into an editable version.

step.name: Click the text you want to fix
step.text: A real editable preview of your document opens. Click any line, paragraph, heading, or table cell, retype it, and press Enter.

step.name: Save and download
step.text: Click 'Save'. Your edits are rebuilt into a real PDF and download immediately.
